The one-sided and bilateral l-infinity contraction constants (1+B)/mu<1 give the unique smooth bounded graph and the unique bounded complete equilibrium. The characteristic polynomial has no unit-circle roots along a coefficient homotopy, giving exponential decay on the graph. A three-equilibrium sine witness verifies sharpness below mu=1+B.
